name: HAI
description: AI copy-trading app: mirror vetted lead traders on Lighter from your own account, with realized-profit-only fees.
longDescription: HAI is a mobile copy-trading app powered by AI-assisted strategies. Users connect once and automatically mirror vetted lead traders on Lighter, in real time and in proportion to their own capital. - Each user has their own dedicated Lighter account. Funds stay in that account and can be withdrawn at any time. - Lead traders' fills are followed live via the Lighter API and mirrored proportionally, including closes and TP/SL. - Users set their own risk limits (stop level) and can pause or stop copying whenever they want. - Fees are charged only on realized profit and settled daily on Arbitrum. - Deposits and withdrawals are in USDC on Arbitrum, directly from the HAI app.
